snippet.title: Sprint City | Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sprint City Early Access is now available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191250/Sprint_City/ 

Sprint City is a shared-world competitive 2D platformer from the original creators of SpeedRunners, where you race as a Runagade across a city built around momentum. Wall-run, grapple, rail grind, and chain together stylish freerunning combos as you master every shortcut and split-second decision.

Follow Sprint City on:
Official website: sprintcity.io
Discord: https://discord.gg/sprintcity
Twitter/X: https://x.com/playsprintcity
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/sprintcity/?type=TEXT
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playsprintcity/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/playsprintcity.bsky.social
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playsprintcity

Get running!
